# Three.js

Vendored ES modules from the npm package `three@0.180.0`. Both files are served
locally; the scene makes no third-party runtime requests. The MIT license is
included in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`. Original project: https://threejs.org/.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

SHA-256:

- three.module.min.js: e2b5ee6bccd38fd6d8a2428546b83c5f2426d84b152ef82be8055556e3b40eb6
- three.core.min.js: 61ba0df005b05991361d040d8ff670e1aadfd0ce7aeebd1fdb0725957a8957de

To update, retrieve an official pinned npm package with npm's integrity checks,
copy both matching build files and the license, update these hashes, and test
WebGL, light/dark themes, and the static fallback. No install step is needed to
run the website.
